caption:
Upstairs, softly lit.

The villa's first-floor living room, seen from every side: sheer curtains along tall windows, a ceiling cove that traces the room, oak shelving lit shelf by shelf, and a red-and-white artwork beside an oak double door. A green-grey corner sofa, an oval marble coffee table and a cognac leather pouf keep it warm and relaxed.

Save it for your next living-room project. Interior design & 3D visualization by KAÏRA Interior Design.
